lines.text: 名字是外婆起的，我不改。

clips.sfx: crackling old audio recording playing through hall speakers, a wave of shocked gasps and rising whispers, a deep ominous bass drone, no voices, no speech

lines.text: 外婆的录音，和二十二年前的证据。
家人们谁懂啊，白莲当场社死。

clips.sfx: confetti softly fluttering, a distant roar of applause, a warm triumphant orchestral finale with gentle chimes, no voices, no speech

lines.text: 那一晚，所有人都在笑我。
现在，他们排队等我回头。
